title: Larry's power ores and weapons
description: A mod that adds a new ore and weapons. (First mod i made)
body:
# What does this mod add?
This mod adds a brand new ore that can be mined and smelted by the player to craft new items! like tools, armor, and other stuff.
## Items
Players can use the new ore (Power ore) To craft a complete set of armor and tools. 
## Special items
- Super eye - used to craft Super Power Eye Sword
- Super Power Sword - crafted using Super Power Ingots and deals a lot of damage. (Slow ATK speed)
- Super Power Eye sword - Super powerful and little bit slow ATK speed
## Recipes
Important recipes can be found in the gallery.
## Bugs/problems
If there are any, then try contacting me in my discord server.
## Future Ideas
I'm thinking about adding another ore that's called gullibulium. (inspired by that one camman18 video).
